verdict.rationale: Drafting AI code fixes and opening pull requests is a fair question for an error-tracking platform, so the axis applies. GlitchTip's evidence shows only a built-in MCP server that lets external AI assistants read error data and resolve issues. That is a building block for other tools, not the platform's own AI drafting fixes or opening PRs, and nothing in the pack documents fix generation or pull-request creation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI can draft a code fix for an error and open a pull request against my repo for human review
